description: This file defines the class 'FormatWithPassportType' which implements a formatter for converting entity values related to passport types, likely within an immigration record context. It retrieves human-readable document type strings from a static map based on an input value.

classes.name: FormatWithPassportType
classes.description: A class implementing the ValueFormatter interface, providing logic to format passport type values by mapping them to descriptive strings.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representing the passport type based on the input entity value, using a static map in EmployeeImmigrationRecord.
